pages.text: A king chose a kind, brave woman named Esther to be his queen. Esther was Jewish, but she kept it secret. Her cousin Mordecai had raised her.
A proud man named Haman wanted to hurt all the Jewish people. Mordecai sent word to Esther: "Maybe you became queen for a time such as this."
Esther was afraid, but she was brave. She asked everyone to pray and fast for three days. Then she went to see the king, even though it was dangerous.
The king welcomed her. Esther invited him and Haman to a feast and told the truth: "Please save me and my people."
The king protected Esther's people, and Haman's plan failed. The people celebrated, because God had used brave Esther to keep them safe.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Esther was afraid, but she prayed and was brave to help others. We can be brave for others, too.
